description.value: Purcell Outdoors is a compact 950-square-foot outdoor gear shop in downtown Kimberley's Platzl, stocking a wide range of brands for trail running, hiking, backpacking, and ski touring. Kimberley sits at the centre of extensive trail networks and is a stop on the Powder Highway, making this a natural resupply point for adventure travellers passing through. Staff are active endurance athletes with deep local knowledge of the surrounding Purcell Mountains terrain.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Purcell Outdoors is an outdoor gear store (OSM tag shop=outdoor) focused on trail running, hiking, camping, and winter sports; the website makes no mention of bike repair services, bike parts, bike pumps, or bike-specific amenities, making the OSM category 'Bike Services' appear incorrect. One team member (Aidan Mckenna) is noted to also work part-time at 'Bootleg Bike Co.' — a separate business — and biking is mentioned only in passing as one of many regional activities. Phone, address, and website all corroborate OSM data exactly.
concerns: OSM category 'Bike Services' does not match the business; shop=outdoor and website content confirm this is an outdoor gear/trail running store with no bike repair or bike parts offering.

One staff member (Aidan Mckenna) works part-time at a separate business 'Bootleg Bike Co.' — that business may be a better fit for the Bike Services category and could warrant its own OSM record check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an outdoor gear store with no evidence of bike-specific services; the 'Bike Services' OSM category appears to be a misclassification. It may warrant inclusion in a broader 'Outdoor Gear & Supplies' directory category useful to touring cyclists, but does not meet WWC Bike Services criteria as currently evidenced.
